brief.request: Сделать мимикрию для ВКонтакте, которая помогает соседям обмениваться редко нужными вещами без общего шумного чата

audience.primary: Жители больших многоквартирных домов, готовые помогать соседям в пределах короткой прогулки
needs: Быстро найти редкую бытовую вещь на один вечер
Понимать, кому можно доверить свою вещь и когда она вернётся

situations: Перед домашней задачей выясняется, что нужный инструмент покупать ради одного раза неразумно
Сосед готов одолжить вещь, если понятны человек, срок и способ возврата
constraints: Ценность должна появиться в пределах одного дома до роста большой сети
Разрешения запрашиваются только из понятного пользовательского действия
Нельзя выдавать fixture evidence за реальные исследования

permissions.constraint: Нужна только для фотографии конкретной предлагаемой вещи
Нужна для выбора ближайшего дома; адрес можно выбрать вручную
Нужна после подписки на запрос или подтверждения выдачи

candidates.name: Круг
candidates.productThesis: Соседи закрывают редкую бытовую задачу через одно обещание выдать и вернуть вещь, а не через бесконечный общий чат.

audience.primary: Жители больших многоквартирных домов, готовые помогать соседям в пределах короткой прогулки
needs: Быстро найти редкую бытовую вещь на один вечер
Понимать, кому можно доверить свою вещь и когда она вернётся

Сосед готов одолжить вещь, если понятны человек, срок и способ возврата

Нельзя выдавать fixture evidence за реальные исследования

reference.mentalModel: Identified people publish social units, respond, converse, and contribute again through a familiar dense feed
reference.naturalFit: Each unit belongs to a person and House graph; value grows through response and repeat contribution rather than passive utility use
reference.productMapping: Borrow request maps to a feed unit; Commitment maps to response and conversation; House scopes discovery
tensions: House privacy must override VK-wide discovery
Commitment state must remain clearer than generic reactions

productContract.productThesis: Соседи закрывают редкую бытовую задачу через одно обещание выдать и вернуть вещь, а не через бесконечный общий чат.

insight.claim: Для редкой вещи главная стоимость — не цена, а неопределённость, у кого она есть и когда её вернут.

job.actor: A resident with an immediate bounded household need
job.situation: The need appears before a task at home
job.motivation: Avoid buying or coordinating more than the task requires
job.outcome: Borrow a nearby item with a clear handoff and return promise

wedge.audience: Residents of one dense apartment building
wedge.situation: A need can be fulfilled within a short walk and clear return window
wedge.mechanism: A time-bounded borrow request becomes a two-party commitment with handoff and return states

observableDifferentiation.behavior: People move from a relevant request to a tracked handoff and return instead of continuing an open chat
observableDifferentiation.comparator: An unstructured neighbourhood chat or city-wide classifieds feed
observableDifferentiation.measurement: Share of opened units that reach a named commitment and completed outcome
observableDifferentiation.threshold: At least one in four relevant opens creates a commitment in the pilot
observableDifferentiation.experiment: Run a four-week two-house pilot and compare completion with the existing house chat
observableDifferentiation.coreLoopStep: Open a relevant borrow request and accept one bounded handoff

userGives: Close the return and publish availability for a future neighbour
A clear time or availability constraint
userGets: Borrow a nearby item with a clear handoff and return promise

relationships: Borrow request belongs to one House
Borrow request links a requester, responder, and Commitment

coldStartSources: House stewards seed verified Borrow request examples with explicit consent
ongoingSources: Residents publish available items after a successful return or from an unresolved request
contributorIncentives: A completed outcome lowers the next neighbour's coordination cost

socialGraphLeverage.relationship: Verified residents and their direct reciprocal commitments
socialGraphLeverage.mechanism: Identity and completion history reduce uncertainty without a public popularity score
socialGraphLeverage.valueWithoutGraph: Seeded current units and manual house choice provide first-session value before friend matches

coldStart.firstSessionValue: Browse current Borrow request examples and complete one bounded task
coldStart.seededContent: Consent-based representative Borrow request entries for the pilot house
coldStart.emptyStateAction: Create the first Borrow request with a guided constraint form

activation.moment: A resident reaches a commitment with a named counterparty and time
activation.window: First seven days after joining a House

coreLoop.trigger: A bounded household need or completed reciprocal action
coreLoop.action: Open a relevant borrow request and accept one bounded handoff
coreLoop.reward: Borrow a nearby item with a clear handoff and return promise
coreLoop.contribution: Close the return and publish availability for a future neighbour
coreLoop.hypothesis: Visible completion makes the next relevant contribution more likely
coreLoop.successMetric: Second completed commitment or contribution within 30 days
coreLoop.testPlan: Pilot two houses and inspect cohort completion plus qualitative failure reasons

habitLoop.cue: A relevant nearby need or return deadline
habitLoop.routine: Open a relevant borrow request and accept one bounded handoff
habitLoop.reward: The task closes with less purchase and coordination
habitLoop.frequency: Event-driven, measured by house rather than assumed daily

reasons: New relevant units appear within one House

permissions.productValue: Publish one photo of the concrete item or place involved
permissions.flow: Create contribution from the relevant detail flow
permissions.requestMoment: Tap Add a current photo in the composer
permissions.deniedFallback: Publish a text description and category without a photo

permissions.productValue: Choose the nearest relevant house without exposing continuous movement
permissions.flow: Select house before entering its scoped feed
permissions.requestMoment: Tap Use my location on house selection
permissions.deniedFallback: Search and select the address manually

permissions.productValue: Receive the answer or commitment the person explicitly follows
permissions.flow: Follow one request or confirm one commitment
permissions.requestMoment: Tap Notify me about this request
permissions.deniedFallback: Show unread state and updates inside the product inbox

trustSafety.reporting: Report remains attached to the person and commitment, with an emergency exit from the flow

data: Selected House, not continuous movement history
principles: Request access at the causal action
Keep denied fallback equivalent where possible
privacy.retention: Expire location-derived selection immediately; retain commitments only for the declared dispute window

businessLogic.model: House-level partner sponsorship after product value is proven
businessLogic.payer: Property operator or local partner, never the resident seeking help
businessLogic.value: Lower duplicated purchases and unresolved household coordination
businessLogic.viabilitySignal: Completed commitments per funded House exceed operating and moderation cost
businessLogic.constraints: No paywall on safety, reporting, or return completion

risks.risk: Supply remains too sparse inside one House
risks.mitigation: Pilot dense houses and seed only consented current entries
risks.killSignal: Fewer than ten relevant units per active House after four weeks

risks.mitigation: Use bounded commitments and neutral handoff points
risks.killSignal: More than half of commitments cancel before handoff

assumptions.claim: One House has enough reciprocal demand
Completion history improves trust without popularity scores
assumptions.validation: Interview both sides after completed and cancelled commitments

evidence.source: fixture assumption requiring a live supply pilot
